title: Positivity of Hedge weights
statement: Fix a learning rate $\eta \in \bbr$, a loss sequence $\ell$ for $N$ experts over $T$ rounds, a time $t$, and an expert $i$. Then the unnormalized Hedge weight $w_t(i) = \exp\!\bigl(-\eta \cdot L_t(i)\bigr)$, where $L_t(i) = \sum_{s < t} \ell_s(i)$ is the cumulative loss of expert $i$ through the first $t$ rounds, is strictly positive.
hypotheses_covered: loss sequence ℓ for N experts over T rounds
replaced:
For any $\eta$, loss sequence $\ell$, time $t$, and expert $i$, the weight
$w_t(i) = \exp(-\eta \cdot L_t(i))$ is strictly positive.
